message:
All three edits are complete and verified:

1. **`src/shared/error-types.ts`** — Changed `ValidationError.statusCode` from `422` to `400`.
2. **`src/shared/base-repository.ts`** — Added optional `PoolClient` parameter to all five CRUD methods (`findById`, `findAll`, `create`, `update`, `delete`) in both the interface and implementation. Each method uses `const executor = client ?? this.pool` to support transactional use.
3. **`tests/unit/shared/types/enums.test.ts`** — Changed imports from individual enum files to the barrel `shared/types`, and added a `'shared/types barrel'` test that verifies all six enums are re-exported from the barrel index.

**Verification**: `tsc --noEmit` passes cleanly, and all 13 tests pass (1 new barrel test + 12 existing enum tests).
